Note: 1. Affidavit should be filed latest by 3.00 PM on the last day of filing
nominations.
Note: 2. Affidavit should be sworn before an Oath Commissioner or Magistrate of
the First Class or before a Notary Public.
Note: 3. All columns should be filled up and no column to be left blank. If there is
no information to furnish in respect of any item, either "Nil" or "Not applicable",
